Rssust 目录 API 指南

Router-name: juejin_pins

Commit time: 2026.07.29
Cookies?: no
Author: AI转写 / huiinyg审核
Introduction: 掘金沸点
Address: rssust://juejin_pins
Example: rssust://juejin_pins?type=hot
Parameter:
1. type
Type of parameter: string
Default value: recommend
Meaning: 沸点分类：recommend(推荐), hot(热门)，或话题ID（如 6824710203301167112=上班摸鱼, 6819970850532360206=内推招聘, 6824710202487472141=一图胜千言, 6824710202562969614=今天学到了, 6824710202378436621=每天一道算法题, 6824710202000932877=开发工具推荐, 6824710203112423437=树洞一下）
